∀ {k : Type} [inst : Field.{0} k] (rho : D₄Rep.{0, 0, 0, 0, 0} k),
  D₄Rep.Indecomposable.{0, 0, 0, 0, 0} rho →
    ExistsUnique.{1} fun d =>
      Nonempty.{1}
        (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.Iso.{0, 0, 0, 0, 0} (D₄Rep.toQuiverRepresentation.{0, 0} rho)
          (D₄Rep.canonicalRepresentation.{0} k d))
